annotations.title: Remove a file from a document

description: Removes one attached file from a document. Readers lose the download from the next time they load the page. It removes the file only: the page, its links and its reading history are untouched, and there is no tool that deletes a page or a link. Claude cannot restore it, and it cannot be recovered from HTMLRadar, so attach it again from the original if the user changes their mind. Take the attachment id from list_attachments.

document_id.description: The document the file is attached to — from list_documents or list_shares.

name: remove_attachment
